title: Revealing the Impact of Visual Text Style on Attribute-based Descriptions Produced by Large Visual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.27553v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When the visual style of text is considered, a wide variety can be observed in font, color, and size. However, when a word is read, its meaning is independent of the style in which it has been written or rendered. In this paper, we investigate whether, and how, the style in which a word is visualized in an image impacts the description that a Large Visual Language Model (LVLM) provides for the concept to which that word refers. Specifically, we investigate how functional text styles (readability-oriented, e.g., black sans-serif) versus decorative styles (display-oriented, e.g., colored cursive/script) affect LVLMs' descriptions of a concept in terms of the attributes of that concept. translated_title: 揭示视觉文本风格对大型视觉语言模型产生的基于属性描述的影响
translated_abstract: 当考虑文本的视觉风格时，可以在字体、颜色和大小等方面观察到广泛的多样性。然而，当一个词被阅读时，其含义与其书写或呈现的风格无关。在本文中，我们研究了一个词在图像中的视觉呈现风格是否以及如何影响大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）对该词所指概念的描述。具体而言，我们研究功能性文本风格（面向可读性，例如黑色无衬线字体）与装饰性风格（面向展示，例如彩色草书/手写体）如何在概念属性层面影响LVLM对概念的描述。我们的实验研究了LVLM能够正确识别视觉文本（即以图像形式呈现的一个或多个单词）所指概念的情形，即在这种情况下视觉文本风格不应影响基于属性的描述。
tldr: 本文首次揭示了图像中文字的视觉呈现风格——功能性风格（如黑色无衬线字体）与装饰性风格（如彩色草书）——会影响大型视觉语言模型对相应概念进行属性描述的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals whether and how the visual style of a word rendered in an image—functional (readability-oriented) versus decorative (display-oriented) styles—affects the attribute-based descriptions that Large Visual Language Models generate for the concept the word refers to.
